Title: Feeling shaky and starving by mid-morning? It might be your coffee habit

Description:
Cortisol starts high the moment you wake up and keeps climbing for the next 30-45 minutes, and caffeine on an empty stomach piles right on top of that rise. One University of Guelph study found drinking coffee before breakfast raised the blood sugar response to that same meal by about 50% compared to coffee after eating.

Eggs, cottage cheese, or pushing your coffee back 45-60 minutes — here's what actually helps before that first cup, backed by real research. Watch to find out why each one works.
